I think the answer is 250. My reasoning is: Five $150 phones cost $750; over three months this is $250 per month.

Shiela purchased five mobile phones, each costing $150, on a three-month payment plan. A one-time 2% charge is applied to each device's price. Can you calculate the amount Shiela will need to pay monthly for the duration of the three months?

What do you think?

Roy has saved 40% more in money earned by chores than his brother Anthony, even after spending $5.00 on a comic book. Anthony has saved $10.00 more than their sister Eva, despite lending $2.00 to a friend. Eva has saved $20.00, after buying a $1.00 candy bar. How much money does Roy have?
